scope: Pre-registered physical sweep protocol; no hardware contact or audio result

evidence_classes.source_fact: Installed trxtrace=on forces VoiceCommand(false); trace is muted and retains 128 admissions

required: Human confirms Pi and Digitakt availability and known routing
Speakers or headphones lowered; monitor starts muted or safely low
Disposable project/pattern and backup of retained user data ready
I04R/I04Q/H02F/stock recovery assets present and unchanged
Human reviewed runbook and paired candidate/recovery state
No agent firmware flash, bootloader/wiring change or computer UI operation
release_gate.if_missing: Record the exact missing input and continue offline work; do not substitute simulation for the physical failure

pass_pairing.audible_pass: trace off, voice armed after a healthy session; capture counters and human observations
pass_pairing.trace_pass: same settings, voice muted by design; enable trxtrace, reproduce, read trxstatus before dumping
pass_pairing.rule: Do not conflate audible and trace passes or infer audible output from a trace run

baseline.note: Historical acceptance records slow/shallow PTCH but not numeric SPD/DEP; recover the accepted setting before treating the grid as absolute

protocol.status_order: trxstatus and status before trxtrace dump
protocol.raw_assets: private only; publish compact timing/status metadata

required_fields: firmware and kernel hashes, Pi uptime/build
LFO destination, SPD, DEP, MULT, FADE, WAVE, SPH, MODE, trig mode
project, pattern, track, sound/lock, note, velocity, routing
start/end FIFO underruns, queue, peak, faults, applied, starts, consumed
retained fault code, block, flags, delta, now, due
USB packet gaps/errors, MIDI bytes/loss/dropped if available
engine block max, CPU core 3, control-pass max, temperature
audio continuity/clicks/stale notes/silence and human UI observation
recovery action: fresh session, reconnect, restart or power cycle

decision_rules.pass: No audio stop, no new FIFO underrun, no fault, no deadline/order/overflow fault, responsive UI, decisive or explicitly non-decisive trace
decision_rules.fail: Any audio stop, fault, queue overflow, UI freeze/sluggishness or stale note; stop and preserve counters/trace
decision_rules.inconclusive: Missing counters/trace or unmatched audible/trace settings; record missing input and do not assign a supported budget point
decision_rules.root_cause: Not claimed until Phase 2 layer isolation

limits: No accepted numeric baseline SPD/DEP is recorded yet
The 128-row trace ring may not cover the full pass/fail interval
Human observations are listening reports, not calibrated latency or UI timing measurements
Phase 1 does not establish a supported dense-modulation budget or root cause
next_action: Recover the accepted numeric PTCH LFO baseline and freeze the release-gate confirmation before executing any physical row
